annotationRationale: The question tests distinguishable linear arrangements with repeated colors. Choosing color positions and removing temporary label multiplicities provide two counting routes with their own concept selections.

classificationReview.areaCheck: Counting & Probability is appropriate; no area repair is needed.

review.questionCheck: There are seven tiles. Independently, choosing brown and purple positions and then an unordered green pair gives \(7\cdot6\cdot\binom{5}{2}=420\), choice B. Equivalently, \(7!/(2!3!)=420\). The statement and key agree, with no figure or grading conflict.
review.alternativeMethodCheck: Both useful supplied routes are retained: choosing color positions and correcting labeled overcounting. No additional route is needed.
review.annotationCheck: The question-level repeated-arrangement annotation is appropriate. The method nodes correctly distinguish combinations and multiplication from permutations and repeated-label correction.
review.areaCheck: Counting & Probability is appropriate; no area repair is needed.

methodReviews.mathCheck: Brown and purple have 7 and 6 positional choices. The remaining green pair has \(5\cdot4/2=10\) choices; yellow positions are forced. The stated one-to-one correspondence prevents omissions and overcounting, giving 420.
methodReviews.sourceMethodCheck: AoPS Solution 2 chooses positions by color. The candidate changes the placement order and independently derives the smaller combination count, so source-informed-original is accurate.
methodReviews.pedagogyCheck: The choice of placement order is motivated. The unordered-pair division, forced final positions, and multiplication are all justified.
methodReviews.directNodeCheck: cnm_h239 precisely covers the unordered green-position choice, and cnm_h231 covers multiplying the successive choice counts.

nativeLayerJudgments.CN: The exact native combination-application and multiplication-principle topics match the derivation.
nativeLayerJudgments.US: The supplied narrower S-CP.B.9 link provides a counting-application connection only. Its rationale mentions compound probability, which this node definition and this method do not establish. No accepted US link is supplied for cnm_h231.
nativeLayerJudgments.ailleo: Both immediate IDs are precise. Omitting the factorial-based multiset node from this particular route is appropriate.

methodReviews.mathCheck: Seven distinct labels produce 5040 rows. Every color row has exactly \(2!3!=12\) labelings, so division gives 420. The multiplicity is uniform across all color arrangements.
methodReviews.sourceMethodCheck: Both cited third-party references use permutation counting followed by repeated-color correction. The temporary-label construction and explanation are independently written, with an honest source-informed-original designation.
methodReviews.pedagogyCheck: Factorial notation is defined, the labeled count is derived, and the exact overcounting factor is explained rather than merely quoted.
methodReviews.directNodeCheck: cnm_h234 applies through the full-permutation case, and math:multiset-permutations exactly covers division by identical-copy factorials.
